explain.summary: What does ‘Missing’ mean, and what do the modes do?
explain.intro: VBA code in Access often relies on components outside Access: Excel or Outlook via COM, functions from Windows DLLs (Declare), files and folders, Shell, the registry, or linked tables on a server. OpenAEC never runs those. The code runs sandboxed on the working copy; no file, program, COM object or DLL is accessed. Such a component is called Missing here. Built in means OpenAEC emulates it itself (VBA, Access, DAO); Partly emulated means only part of it works (for Scripting, only Dictionary).
explain.runnable: A procedure is runnable if it (including the procedures it calls) needs nothing that is missing; partly runnable if the missing part sits only behind error handling or a condition.
explain.modes: You choose what happens when the code does reach a missing component:

query.passthroughConnection: Pass-through query: the ODBC connection string is present but is not shown or exported, because it may contain sign-in details.

query.notReconstructed: SQL not reconstructed: {{error}}. The raw definition has been kept; nothing was guessed.

analysis.executionNote: Opening does not run any queries, macros, VBA, AutoExec or linked sources. The original is not changed.
analysis.noCompoundFile: MSysAccessObjects does not contain a compound file.
analysis.rowCountDiffers: Record count differs: table definition {{definition}}, own page scan {{scan}}.
analysis.tablesUnreadable: Columns not readable because of unsupported data types in: {{tables}}.
analysis.tablesRead: User tables, field names, data types and record counts via mdb-reader; data in pages of 200 records.
analysis.rowCountsDiffer: Own page scan differs for: {{tables}}. See the table limitations.
analysis.rowCountsMatch: The own scan of data pages matches the table definition for all tables.
analysis.indexesFailed_other: The raw table definition could not be read for {{count}} tables.
analysis.indexesRead: Read from the table definition pages with its own reader (names, fields, primary, unique, relationship index).
analysis.linkedInventoryOnly: Inventory only. The external source is not opened; the connection string is not shown.
analysis.linkedNamesOnly: Only names inventoried; external sources are not opened.
analysis.relationshipsRead: From MSysRelationships: tables, fields, integrity and cascading actions.
analysis.systemRelationships_other: {{count}} internal Access relationships between system tables are not included in the object browser.
analysis.hiddenSystemQuery: Yes, system query for a form, report or control
analysis.queriesReconstructed: SQL reconstructed from MSysQueries for {{done}} of {{total}}.

inventoryOnly.form: Inventory only (name and type from MSysObjects). Forms are not displayed or run.
inventoryOnly.report: Inventory only (name and type from MSysObjects). Reports are not displayed or run.
inventoryOnly.macro: Inventory only (name and type from MSysObjects). Macros are not displayed or run.

analysis.inventoryNamesOnly: Only name and type inventoried; design and behavior are not displayed or run.
analysis.rawRoute: {{table}} was read with the own row reader because mdb-reader failed ({{error}}).
analysis.rawRouteSkipped_other: {{table}} was read with the own row reader because mdb-reader failed ({{error}}); {{count}} unreadable rows skipped.
analysis.access97Modules: Access 97 module storage (MSysModules2) is not decoded.
analysis.noProjectInReadableRows: No VBA project found in the readable rows; it may be in the skipped rows.
analysis.streamMissing: Source code not recovered: the module stream is missing from the VBA project.
analysis.compiledOnly: No source code present, only compiled code (for example MDE/ACCDE). Nothing was recovered.
analysis.sourceRecovered_other: Source code recovered for {{done}} of {{count}} modules with its own MS-OVBA decompression.
analysis.dirNoModules: The dir stream lists no modules.
analysis.msysModules_other: MSysObjects lists {{count}} standard or class modules.
analysis.projectLocked: The project is locked for viewing.
analysis.noPasswordTried: No password was requested or tried; tables, queries, relationships and VBA were not read.

ovba.fatOutside: CFB FAT points outside the file.
ovba.copyTokenOutside: MS-OVBA copy token points outside the chunk.
ovba.dirTruncated: The VBA dir stream is truncated.
ovba.noSourceOffset: Module {{name}} has no source offset in the dir stream.

bridge.unknownError: Unknown error in the working copy.
bridge.methodMissing: This working copy has no method ‘{{method}}’.
bridge.timeout_other: The working copy did not respond within {{count}} seconds ({{method}}).
bridge.disconnected: The connection to the working copy was lost.

build.tooLarge: Choose a database of at most 100 MB.
build.headerUnreadable: File header not read; indexes and primary keys are therefore missing: {{error}}
build.catalogUnreadable: The system catalog (MSysObjects) cannot be read; the file may be encrypted, password-protected or damaged: {{error}}
build.reservedTableName: The table name conflicts with a reserved name of the working copy; the table was not imported.
build.complexField: Field ‘{{field}}’ is a complex field (attachment or multivalued). In the working copy it contains the file names; attachments are stored in _openaec_bijlagen. Multivalued data is not imported and is reported per record.
build.unknownFieldType: Field ‘{{field}}’ has an unknown data type ({{type}}); the values were imported as text.
build.decimalPrecision: Field ‘{{field}}’ is Decimal with precision {{precision}}; SQLite stores it as REAL (about 15 significant digits).
build.columnsUnreadable: Fields not readable; the table was not imported: {{error}}
build.primaryKeyUnknownColumns: Primary key ‘{{name}}’ refers to unknown fields and was not imported.
build.tableDefUnreadable: Raw table definition not read; primary key and indexes are missing: {{error}}
build.linkedOdbc: ODBC link; the external source is not opened and the table is not in the working copy.
build.linkedAccess: Link to another Access database; the external source is not opened and the table is not in the working copy.
build.relationTableMissing: table {{table}} is not in the working copy
build.relationFieldMissing: a field of the relationship does not exist
build.relationNoUniqueTarget: the referenced fields in {{table}} are not a primary key or unique index
build.relationNotEnforced: Access enforces referential integrity, but the working copy cannot import it as a FOREIGN KEY: {{reason}}. The relationship was recorded as not enforced.
build.relationshipsUnreadable: MSysRelationships not read; no relationships were imported: {{error}}
build.noColumns: The table has no fields; an empty table with only a row ID was created.
build.deletedRowsSkipped_other: {{count}} deleted or outdated record versions in the file were skipped; {{live}} live record(s) according to the own page scan.
build.scanMismatch: The file contains deleted or moved records, but the own page scan does not match mdb-reader (scan {{scan}}, mdb-reader {{reader}}, live {{live}}, table definition {{definition}}). All records read by mdb-reader were imported, possibly including old record versions.
build.scanFailed: Own page scan failed; deleted records were not filtered out: {{error}}
build.fieldUnreadable: Field ‘{{field}}’ cannot be read ({{error}}); the values from record {{row}} onward were left empty, the other fields were imported.
build.rowsUnreadableFrom_other: Records from number {{row}} onward cannot be read ({{error}}); {{count}} records imported.

problem.extendedDate: unknown extended date format, stored as text
problem.numberUnreadable: number not readable, stored as text
problem.decimalRounded: Decimal with more than 15 digits, rounded to REAL
problem.bigint: large integer outside the safe range, stored as text
problem.multiValue: multivalued data or unknown complex content not imported

build.rowsWithoutHeavy_other: {{count}} records imported without Long Text and binary fields, because those could not be read: {{error}}
build.rowsUnreadable_other: {{count}} records could not be read and were not imported: {{error}}
build.rowsSkipped_other: {{count}} records not imported, for example because of a duplicate primary key: {{error}}
build.rowCountDiffers: Record count differs: table definition {{definition}}, read {{read}}.
build.indexUnknownColumns: Index ‘{{name}}’ refers to unknown fields and was not created.
build.indexNotUnique: Index ‘{{name}}’ is unique in the table definition, but the data read contains duplicate values; created as a regular index ({{error}}).
build.relationViolations_other: {{count}} records violate an enforced relationship (already so in the original). New changes are checked.
build.queriesUnreadable: MSysQueries not read; no queries were imported: {{error}}
build.modulesImported_other: {{count}} VBA modules with source code imported into _openaec_modules. VBA is never run automatically.
build.formsReports: The original contains {{forms}} form(s) and {{reports}} report(s). Their Access design is not imported; new designs are saved in _openaec_ontwerpen.
build.failed: The working copy could not be built: {{error}}

accessSql.unterminatedString: Text without a closing quotation mark
accessSql.unknownStatement: Unknown statement; expected SELECT, TRANSFORM, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE or DDL
accessSql.quantifiedComparison: Comparison ‘{{op}} {{quantifier}} (SELECT …)’ is not supported; only = ANY/SOME and <> ALL (as IN and NOT IN).
accessSql.indexOptionExpected: PRIMARY, DISALLOW NULL or IGNORE NULL expected
accessSql.checkNotTranslated: CHECK constraints in Access DDL are not translated.
accessSql.constraintExpected: PRIMARY KEY, UNIQUE or FOREIGN KEY expected
accessSql.dropNotSupported: DROP {{what}} is not supported in the working copy.
accessSql.addConstraint: SQLite cannot run ALTER TABLE … ADD CONSTRAINT on an existing table.
accessSql.dropConstraint: SQLite cannot run ALTER TABLE … DROP CONSTRAINT on an existing table.
accessSql.alterColumn: ALTER TABLE … ALTER COLUMN (changing the data type) is not supported in the working copy.
accessSql.hiddenComplexTable: ‘{{name}}’ is the hidden helper table of a multivalued or attachment field; it is not imported into the working copy.
accessSql.systemTable: ‘{{name}}’ is an Access system table; system tables are not imported into the working copy.
accessSql.linkedTable: ‘{{name}}’ is a linked table ({{kind}}); the external source is not opened and is not in the working copy.
accessSql.objectMissing: Table or query ‘{{name}}’ does not exist in the working copy.
accessSql.circularQuery: Circular reference: query ‘{{name}}’ refers (indirectly) to itself.
accessSql.queryNotSource: Query ‘{{name}}’ is a {{kind}} query and cannot be used as a source.
accessSql.notSelectQuery: Query ‘{{name}}’ is not a select query.
accessSql.domainLiteralOnly: {{fn}}: only literal text arguments are translated (a composite criterion such as "ID=" & [ID] is evaluated per record in VBA and is not supported here).
accessSql.switchPairs: Switch expects pairs of condition and value.
accessSql.chooseArgs: Choose expects an index and at least one choice.
accessSql.replaceArgs: Replace with a start, count or compare argument is not supported; only Replace(expression, find, replace).
accessSql.eval: Eval runs text as an expression and is not supported in the working copy.
accessSql.unknownFunction: Function ‘{{fn}}’ is not an Access function known to the working copy; it may be a VBA function from a module, and VBA is not run in queries.
accessSql.firstWeek: DatePart/DateDiff with a different first week of the year (vbFirstFourDays/vbFirstFullWeek) is not supported.
accessSql.externalTable: Table ‘{{name}}’ comes from an external database (IN '…'); it is not opened.
accessSql.unionOrderBy: ORDER BY in a union query can only contain field names or column numbers.
accessSql.starNotInFrom: ‘{{table}}.*’ refers to a table that is not in FROM.
accessSql.pivotLiterals: PIVOT … IN (…) can only contain literal values.
accessSql.crosstabTooWide: The crosstab would get {{count}} columns; Access allows at most 254.
accessSql.transformAggregate: The TRANSFORM expression of a crosstab must contain an aggregate function.
accessSql.targetNotInSources: {{statement}}: ‘{{name}}’ is not in the sources of the query; Access would treat it as a parameter and cannot update it.
accessSql.targetIsQuery: {{statement}}: ‘{{name}}’ is a query, not a table; updating through a query is not supported.
accessSql.updateFieldMissing: UPDATE: field ‘{{name}}’ does not occur in any of the tables.
accessSql.updateIsQuery: UPDATE: ‘{{name}}’ is a query, not a table.
accessSql.updateMultiTable: UPDATE changes fields in more than one table ({{a}} and {{b}}); SQLite can only update one table per statement.
accessSql.deleteMultiTable: DELETE from more than one table at once ({{a}} and {{b}}) is not supported.
accessSql.deleteWhichTable: DELETE with multiple tables must specify which table to delete from (DELETE Table.* FROM …).
accessSql.deleteIsQuery: DELETE: ‘{{name}}’ is a query, not a table.
accessSql.insertExternal: INSERT INTO an external database (IN '…') is not supported.
accessSql.targetLinked: Target table ‘{{name}}’ is a linked table ({{kind}}); the external source is not opened or changed.
accessSql.targetMissing: Target table ‘{{name}}’ does not exist in the working copy.
accessSql.fieldNotInTable: Field ‘{{field}}’ does not exist in table ‘{{table}}’.
accessSql.ddlTypeNotSupported: Data type ‘{{type}}’ in Access DDL is not supported.
accessSql.primaryKeyUnknownField: Primary key refers to unknown field ‘{{name}}’.
accessSql.indexWithPrimary: CREATE INDEX … WITH PRIMARY: SQLite cannot add a primary key to an existing table.
accessSql.addColumnKey: SQLite cannot run ALTER TABLE … ADD COLUMN with PRIMARY KEY or UNIQUE.
accessSql.passthroughNamed: Query ‘{{name}}’ is a pass-through query: the SQL is intended for an external ODBC server and is not run in the working copy.
accessSql.passthrough: A pass-through query: the SQL is intended for an external ODBC server and is not run in the working copy.
accessSql.intoFirstPart: INTO can only appear in the first part of a UNION.
accessSql.selectIntoExternal: SELECT … INTO an external database (IN '…') is not supported.
